name: Possessions
overview: Scripture teaches that earthly and material possessions are temporary and subject to decay, urging believers not to store up treasures on earth but to seek eternal treasures in heaven (Matthew 6:19; Luke 12:33). Life's true value is not measured by abundance of possessions, as covetousness is warned against (Luke 12:15). The early church exemplified this by sharing all things in common, demonstrating a heart united in generosity and care for others (Acts 4:32; Acts 20:35). Ultimately, God regards His people as His special treasure, emphasizing the eternal significance of our relationship with Him over material wealth (Malachi 3:17).
